FacialProfile.title: FacialProfile
FacialProfile.description: Stores enrolled employee identity details and normalized cloud facial biometric traits for cross-device recognition.

ownerId.description: Authenticated user UID who owns or enrolled this record.

fullName.description: Full legal or display name of the enrolled person.

employeeCode.description: Unique employee or member identifier badge code.

branch.description: Assigned organizational branch or campus location.

traitSignature.description: Serialized normalized 64-point facial feature vector for biometric cosine matching.

interocularRatio.description: Normalized interocular distance to facial width ratio.

symmetryScore.description: Biometric bilateral facial symmetry score from 0 to 100.

descriptorHash.description: Hexadecimal checksum of the facial trait vector.

status.description: Current enrollment status of the facial profile.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the facial profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the facial profile was last updated.

AttendanceLog.title: AttendanceLog
AttendanceLog.description: Records a verified facial recognition attendance check-in with timestamp, branch, biometric confidence, and GPS geolocation.

ownerId.description: Authenticated user UID who recorded this attendance log.

profileId.description: Document ID of the matched FacialProfile.

fullName.description: Full name of the person whose attendance was recorded.

employeeCode.description: Employee badge code at time of check-in.

branch.description: Branch associated with the attendance record.

matchConfidence.description: Biometric facial similarity confidence score (0 to 100).

latitude.description: GPS latitude coordinate where attendance was captured (-90 to 90).

longitude.description: GPS longitude coordinate where attendance was captured (-180 to 180).

locationName.description: Resolved location description and coordinate summary.

monthKey.description: Year-month partition string (YYYY-MM) for monthly report aggregation.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when attendance was logged.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest record modification.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator registry document keyed by user UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin privilege was granted.

/facialProfiles/{profileId}.description: Cloud store of enrolled user facial biometric traits and identity metadata.

/attendanceLogs/{logId}.description: Real-time facial recognition attendance records with geolocation coordinates.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Registry of administrator UIDs used by security rules for elevated access.
